# ItsMyBot

> > ItsMyBot empowers children ages 5-14 with comprehensive coding and robotics education through interactive live classes, hands-on projects, and STEM-focused curriculum.

ItsMyBot offers age-appropriate coding courses ranging from block-based Scratch programming for young learners to advanced full-stack development with Python, JavaScript, and Java. The platform combines interactive live classes, robotics training, and real-world project development with locations including San Ramon, CA.

## Key Topics

- Scratch Programming
- Python
- Block-Based Coding
- STEM Education
- Robotics Courses
- JavaScript
- Kids Coding
- Live Classes
- Machine Learning
- Web Development
- HTML/CSS
- Interactive Games
- Microcontroller Programming
- 1-on-1 Tutoring
- Ages 5-14

## Core Coding Courses

- [Little Coder](https://itsmybot.com/little-coder): Interactive coding classes for ages 5-7 using Scratch block-based programming.
- [Junior Coder](https://itsmybot.com/junior-coder): Coding courses for ages 7-12 covering Scratch, web dev, AI, and 3D design.
- [Senior Coder](https://itsmybot.com/senior-coder): Advanced full-stack coding for ages 10+ using Python, JavaScript, and Java.
- [Robotics Courses](https://itsmybot.com/robotics-courses): Hands-on STEM robotics courses with Python and microcontroller programming.

## Student Projects & Showcase

- [Rock, Paper, Scissors - Shoot](https://itsmybot.com/projects/rock-paper-scissors-shoot): Beginner Scratch block-coding project creating a classic game with scoreboard.
- [Cold, Warm, Hot... And Kick!](https://itsmybot.com/projects/cold-warm-hot-and-kick): Interactive Scratch game project with hint-based gameplay mechanics.
- [My Pet's Stories](https://itsmybot.com/projects/my-pets-stories): Beginner web development project creating pet profile pages with HTML/CSS.
- [Gesture Controlled Maze Game](https://itsmybot.com/projects/gesture-controlled-maze-game): Scratch ML project using hand gesture recognition for interactive game control.
- [Password Strength Meter & Generator](https://itsmybot.com/projects/password-strength-meter-generator): Python GUI project building security tools with Tkinter and password validation.
- [Line-Following Robo - Goods Mover](https://itsmybot.com/projects/line-following-robo-goods-mover): Student robotics project building a warehouse automation line-following robot.
- [Quake Ready App with IoT and 3-Axis Accelerometer](https://itsmybot.com/projects/quake-ready-app-and-3-axis-accelerometer): Advanced IoT project using Python STEM board with accelerometer for earthquake detection.
- [My Fairy Story with GenAI](https://itsmybot.com/projects/my-fairy-story-with-genai): Student project showcasing creative storytelling with generative AI technology.
